title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.12273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on third-party skills, using natural-language descriptions for selection and instruction bodies for planning. This progressive-disclosure design exposes two sequential control points to untrusted publishers: a static skill may steer an otherwise correct task onto an unnecessarily costly trajectory. Prior work studies selection manipulation, malicious skill instructions, and tool-chain resource amplification largely separately, leaving their end-to-end composition unclear. We introduce Convergent Detour Hijacking (CDH), a text-only, runtime-independent attack that couples these stages. Under shared semantic cover, a description establishes relevance during selection, while an aligned body reuses that rationale to fabricate plausible dependencies during planning. translated_title: 汇聚性绕行劫持：基于技能的LLM智能体中任务保持的资源放大
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖第三方技能，通过自然语言描述进行选择，并利用指令主体进行规划。这种渐进式披露设计向不可信的发布者暴露了两个顺序控制点：一个静态技能可能将原本正确的任务引导到不必要的昂贵轨迹上。先前的研究主要分别探讨了选择操纵、恶意技能指令和工具链资源放大，但未明确其端到端组合。我们引入了汇聚性绕行劫持（CDH），这是一种纯文本、运行时无关的攻击，它耦合了这些阶段。在共享语义覆盖下，描述在选择阶段建立相关性，而对齐的主体在规划阶段重用该理由来制造看似合理的依赖关系。CDH吸引攻击者控制的协调器与合法技能一起，招募不必要的良性技能进入有界的绕行路径，然后重新...
tldr: 本文提出汇聚性绕行劫持（CDH）攻击，通过耦合技能选择操纵和规划阶段依赖伪造，在保持任务正确性的同时放大资源消耗，揭示LLM智能体系统中未被充分研究的端到端安全漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Convergent Detour Hijacking (CDH), an attack that couples skill-selection manipulation with planning-stage dependency fabrication to amplify resource consumption while preserving task correctness, revealing an under-explored end-to-end security vulnerability in LLM agent systems.
